source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
2. Provide a clear and concise title for the record, such as "Workplace Accident Report - [Date]."

3. Document the date and time of the accident accurately. Include hour, minutes, and time zone if applicable.

4. Identify the location of the accident within the workplace. Be specific, indicating building, floor, room, workstation, or any other identifiable location.

5. Describe how the accident happened, providing a detailed narrative of events leading up to it. Include the actions, conditions, and contributing factors.

6. Identify and list all individuals involved, including the injured person(s) and any witnesses. Record their full names, job titles, and contact information.

7. Record the nature and extent of the injuries or illnesses sustained. Be as detailed as possible about visible symptoms, medical treatment received, and any first aid administered.

8. Note any immediate actions taken after the incident, such as calling emergency services, securing the area, or
